summary.result: The result showed that prediction values proposed by Matlock & Reese , Chang and Broms were smaller that real values.
summary.background: Recently, the calculation of horizontal bearing capacity of piles foundation has been considered very important for earthquake or wind resistant design in Korea.
summary.method: Three proposed methods by Matlock & Reese and Chang based on lateral deflection and Broms by ultimated lateral resistance turned out valid in view of engineering practice.
